newsitem.title: UK: European raw cotton markets find bullish sentiment.
newsitem.headline: European raw cotton markets find bullish sentiment.

text.p: Attention in the European raw cotton markets centred on the USDA's latest U.S. production forecast, industry sources said.
This was several hundred thousand bales lower than that of a month ago, they added.

Before the news, most mill buyers were cautious about adding to purchasing commitments. However, attractive asking rates for central Asian styles generated additional buying support in Belgium and France.
A broader interest was also shown in Greek styles, notably in Italy.
